Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

This is an interface-integrity boundary, not a claim that the public light-curve data are proprietary.

NED host queries require one unambiguous host identity; transient coordinates are not silently substituted.

NOIRLab's provider-owned API authentication notebook states that anyone may retrieve public files while proprietary-file retrieval requires authorization. This adapter sends no credential and retains a product only after an exact file-metadata lookup supplies a nonblank release_date no later than the query time.
